gallery.description: U.S. Army Sgt. 1st Class Marites Cabreza, a medical technician with the 354th Civil Affairs Brigade, checks the breathing of a young child during a medical civil affairs project (MEDCAP) in Beya-Addey, Djibouti. gallery.description: U.S. Air Force Senior Airman Kristopher Tomes, a pararescueman with the 82nd Expeditionary Rescue Squadron, jumps from a HC-130 following his re-enlistment near Camp Lemonnier, Djibouti, Nov. 19, 2013. gallery.description: U.S. Navy Lt. Cmdr. Jon Wilson, a future operations country planner assigned to Combined Joint Task Force-Horn of Africa, crosses the finish line at the 16th Annual Djibouti International Semi-Marathon in Djibouti March 3, 2012. More than 40 U.S. Service members and civilians assigned to Camp Lemonnier, Djibouti, ran alongside 800 international runners during the event. (DoD photo by Tech. Sgt. gallery.description: U.S. Secretary of Defense Leon Panetta addresses U.S. Service members at Camp Lemonnier, Djibouti, Dec. 13, 2011. Panetta discussed the Department of Defense budget and other issues with the troops. (U.S. Air Force photo by Staff Sgt. Marc Lane/Released)

gallery.title: File:110525-F-XM360-119 (5765219674).jpg
gallery.artist: U.S. Department of Defense Current Photos
gallery.description: U.S. Air Force Col. Michael D. Morelock, left, the commander of the 449th Air Expeditionary Group, shakes hands with Djiboutian Air Force (DJAF) Maj. Ali Chakib following a tour of the DJAF hangar in Djibouti May 25, 2011. Morelock visited the DJAF leadership to establish a lasting relationship between the air forces at the leadership and technician levels.

gallery.title: File:110505-F-CU786-033 (5731047160).jpg
gallery.artist: U.S. Department of Defense Current Photos
gallery.description: U.S. Army Capt. Vincent Fry performs a check on a child from Obock, Djibouti, during a recent medical capacity program (MEDCAP) mission May 5, 2011. Fry and other medical experts from Combined Joint Task Force - Horn of Africa treated more than 1,800 patients for a variety of ailments during the two-day MEDCAP. (DoD photo by Lt. Col. Leslie Pratt, U.S. Air Force/Released)

gallery.title: File:110331-N-SN160-035 (5598443850).jpg
gallery.artist: U.S. Department of Defense Current Photos
gallery.description: 110331-N-SN160-035 DJIBOUTI - (March. 31, 2011) U.S. Navy Petty Officer 3rd Class Caleb Baker and U.S. Navy Constructionman Eric Hofmans, both Seabee constructionmen assigned to Naval Mobile Construction Battalion (NMCB) 74 Detail Horn of Africa (Det, HOA), take a break from pouring a concrete wall around the recently constructed Ecole 5 primary school in Djibouti, March 31.  NMCB 74 Det. HOA is deployed to support Combined Joint Task Force – Horn of Africa in building partner nation capacity and promoting regional stability through construction engineering support. (U.S. Navy photo by Petty Officer 2nd Class Michael Lindsey)

gallery.title: File:110313-N-EF657-027 (5529391088).jpg
gallery.artist: U.S. Department of Defense Current Photos
gallery.description: U.S. Army General Carter Ham, U.S. Africa Command commander, center left, is escorted by U.S. Navy Captain Darius Banaji, Camp Lemonnier commanding officer, center, and U.S. Navy Rear Admiral Brian Losey, Combined Joint Task Force-Horn of Africa commander, right, during a tour at Camp Lemonnier, Djibouti , March 13, 2011. Ham met with U.S. military leaders, the Djiboutian chief of defense and the U.S. Ambassador to Djibouti. (DoD photo by Mass Communication Specialist 2nd Class Timothy Wilson, U.S. Navy/Released)

gallery.title: File:.50 Cal 101 (11855055116).jpg
gallery.artist: Marines from Arlington, VA, United States
gallery.description:
Sgt. Robert M. Bagley, a scout sniper with Special-Purpose Marine Air-Ground Task Force from Houston, Texas, explains the nomenclature for a .50 caliber special- application scoped rifle to Marines and sailors while in Entebbe, Uganda, December 27. The Marines from SP-MAGTF Crisis Response are currently postured in Camp Lemonnier, Djibouti and Entebbe, Uganda, to better respond to any threats against U.S personnel and interests in South Sudan.

(U.S. Marine Corps photo by Staff Sgt. Robert Fisher III/Released)

gallery.title: File:02-09JUL2019 CNGB USO Tour 2019 190707-N-WU565-900 (48531457526).jpg
gallery.artist: Chief National Guard Bureau from USA
gallery.description: CAMP LEMONNIER, Djibouti – U.S. Air Force Gen. Joseph L. Lengyel, 28th Chief of the National Guard Bureau and member of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, and celebrity guest performers on the 2019 USO Star Spangled Variety Tour, pose for photos with forward-deployed U.S. Army Soldiers from the 44th Brigade Combat Team, 2nd Battalion, 113th Infantry Regiment, Task Force Warrior, New Jersey Army National Guard during a visit on base, July 7, 2019. The last stop on the annual USO Tour led by Gen. Lengyel, included six countries in Europe, Southwest Asia and Africa, designed to boost morale and express thanks and appreciation to deployed U.S. forces and their families for their service and sacrifice in support of the Joint Force mission. Performers on the tour include: actress Mayim Bialik (The Big Bang Theory); singer Laura Bryna; comedian Anjelah Johnson; Nia Franklin (2019 Miss America); actress Toni Trucks (Seal Team); The Voice champion singer Cassadee Pope; and former UFC champion Quinton “Rampage” Jackson. (U.S. Navy photo by Mass Communication Specialist 2nd Class Orlando Quintero)

gallery.title: File:130125-Z-DS155-008 (8450640635).jpg
gallery.artist: U.S. Department of Defense Current Photos
gallery.description: CAMP LEMONNIER, DJIBOUTI (Jan. 25, 2013) -Members of the 22nd Airlift Squadron from Travis Air Force Base and members of the new 303rd Emergency Rescue Squadron here, unload one of three HH60 helicopters from a C5 Galaxy.  The squadron is replacing the Heavy Marine Helicopter 464th Detachment A, who has been handling the mission here for the past ten years.  The arrival of the 303rd will better equip Combined Joint Task Force-Horn of Africa for personnel recovery due to the helicopters’ capabilities.  This is one more tool that CJTF-HOA uses to be the preferred security partner of choice in an increasingly secure, stable, and developing East Africa. (U.S. Air Force photo by Staff Sgt. Jonathan Young)

gallery.title: File:120819-M-KU932-007 (7832932114).jpg
gallery.artist: U.S. Department of Defense Current Photos
gallery.description: U.S. Marines with the 24th Marine Expeditionary Unit (MEU) take part in an acclimatization test at Camp Lemonnier, Djibouti, Aug. 19, 2012. The test consisted of a three-mile run while carrying a 30-pound pack. A contingent of the 24th MEU was in Djibouti conducting unilateral, bilateral and joint exercises with U.S. and foreign militaries. The 24th MEU was deployed with the Iwo Jima Amphibious Ready Group as a theater reserve and crisis response force throughout the U.S. Central and Africa Commands in the U.S. 5th Fleet area of responsibility. (DoD photo by Cpl. Michael Petersheim, U.S. Marine Corps/Released)
